author: Mark Manson
description: People in the most toxic relationships often feel the most guilt about leaving. They hate the situation, still love their partner, and feel trapped between knowing they deserve better and feeling like they can’t walk away.
title: Why You Think It's All Your Fault

Nobody gives you a manual for being an adult. You’re expected to work out money, emotions, relationships, and everything else through trial and a lot of error.

So here’s the manual. In this video, I go through 33 things every adult should have. Some are practical, some are social, and a few are the uncomfortable internal ones most of us avoid. How many can you already do?
title: 33 Things Everyone Should Know How To Do
